这是我的 AnimateDiff 工作流程的 SDXL 版本，许多人已经了解并喜爱它。它包含所有相同的功能，例如主题的特定 alpha 掩码，因此您可以准确地使用主题区分 IP 适配器。这些组都带有标签，应该很容易导航。

一些注意事项：

SDXL 和 HotShotXL 一直比 1.5 更难使用。此工作流程专门适用于 SDXL 4 Step Lightning LoRA，因此您需要下载它。另外，唯一真正对我有用的型号是 DynavisionXL。如果您选择使用该模型和 LoRA 之外的任何内容，那是您的决定。

o.en:
NOTE:

I am uploading this so that someone smarter than me can improve on it and we can have a DANK SDXL animatediff workflow. If you do so, please share it with everyone as I did mine :)

This is the SDXL version of my AnimateDiff workflow that many people have come to know and love. It includes all the same goodies like a specific alpha mask for the subject so you can accurately use subject differentiating IP adapters. The groups are all labeled and it should be pretty easy to navigate.

A few considerations:

SDXL and HotShotXL have always been harder to work with than 1.5. This workflow specifically works with the SDXL 4 Step Lightning LoRA, so you will need to download that. Also, the only model that has really worked for me with this has been DynavisionXL. If you choose to use anything outside of that model and LoRA, that's your call.
